description: Get unified ownership breakdown for a company combining Form 4 insider holdings, 13F institutional holdings, and 13D/13G activist positions. All entities are resolved across the three SEC form types into a single view with counterparty resolution. The allHolders array is paginated via limit/offset (default 100). Aggregate stats (institutional/insider/beneficial totals and percentages, plus the `retail` residual) are always included in full. `retail` is the UNATTRIBUTED residual: shares no filing accounts for, which includes recent offering buyers and acquisition holders who have not filed as well as retail investors — an upper bound on retail, never a retail count. When `retail.reason` is `filed_exceeds_outstanding` the residual is withheld (null) because the counted filings exceed the shares outstanding. 🔴 A bucket (`institutional` / `insider` / `beneficial`) whose shares exceed the shares outstanding by more than a 2% timing tolerance has its `percentOfOutstanding` WITHHELD — null, with `percentWithheldReason: "ownership_exceeds_outstanding"` — and its `totalShares` still published: the percent would not be a measurement (filings on another share basis such as ordinary shares against an ADS count, another class reported under this one, shares lent and reported by both lender and buyer, or filings dated before a buyback or redemption). Report the share figure and the reason; NEVER present such a bucket as 100%, as 0%, or as any percent. When any bucket is withheld, `retail.reason` is `ownership_exceeds_outstanding` and `filedSumPercent` is absent. A null percent with NO `percentWithheldReason` means no share count was available — not measured for a different reason. `sharesOutstanding` is the denominator of every percentage and is DATED: `sharesOutstandingAsOf` + `sharesOutstandingAsOfKind` ("stated" = the issuer's statement date; "checked" = when the figure was last confirmed against a vendor; "none" = date not recorded) and `sharesOutstandingSource` (a vendor-free label). Never present a count without its date. `beneficial.staleShares` / `stalePercentOfOutstanding` / `staleHolderCount` is a MEASURED SUBSET of the counted 5%+ total resting on 13D/G schedules >= 24 months old with no newer reaffirming filing by the same holder family — not a deduction; the total still includes it. A row's `reaffirmedBy` names the newer family filing; `staleFiling.ageMonths` marks a counted row with none. `stalePercentOfOutstanding: null` is not measurable (no share count), never zero.

limit.description: Maximum holders to return in allHolders (default: 100, max: 100)

name: get_ownership
